## SWISS RSE Day

Research software engineers from [academia]{style="color: #577399;"}, [research institutes]{style="color: #BDD5EA;"}, and [industry]{style="color: #FE5F55;"} spent a full day together at ETH Zurich.

::: {.nonincremental}
- 31 August 2026, 09:00–17:00
- CAB, ETH Zurich
- 26 talks - 2 keynotes
- Close to 150 attendees
- [Event page](https://rse.swiss/swiss_rse_day/)
:::
